name: Grade 10 English Term 1 Exam
subject: English
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Read the passage and answer the questions that follow.

items.question: Which of these is a synonym of 'commence'?
Identify the figure of speech in 'the wind whistled through the trees'.
Which sentence is correctly punctuated?
options: Its a fine day isn't it
It's a fine day, isn't it?
It's a fine day, isn't it.
items.answer: It's a fine day, isn't it?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. Read the passage and state the main idea in one sentence. (4 marks)
2. Identify two figures of speech used in the passage and give an example of each. (4 marks)
3. Write a synonym for each of the following words as used in the passage: remote, abundant, reluctant. (3 marks)
4. Rewrite the following sentence in the passive voice: 'The teacher praised the students.' (2 marks)
5. Complete the following sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets. (3 marks)
6. Write a composition of about 250 words on 'The importance of conserving the environment'. (20 marks)
